title: studio.page.created.v1
description: A studio owner or admin created a builder page (synthwerk#46, #106). The page has a draft and no live version yet. CloudEvents subject: the page id. The orgid extension and data.org_id hold the identity org id. actor: user:<sub> of the owner or admin. No page content: no title, no section text. Identity copies it to the audit list of the org.

slug.description: URL slug of the page. Never free text.
